stripe webhook: verify stripe-signature header against STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, parse event from body, dispatch by event type, return 200 on success / 400-401 on bad sig.
github webhook: verify x-hub-signature-256 header against GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET, parse event from body, dispatch by event type, return 200 on success / 400-401 on bad sig.
clerk webhook: verify svix-signature header against CLERK_WEBHOOK_SECRET, parse event from body, dispatch by event type, return 200 on success / 400-401 on bad sig.
resend webhook: verify resend-signature header against RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET, parse event from body, dispatch by event type, return 200 on success / 400-401 on bad sig.
